lm.title: Local media
lm.intro: Play your own music from a folder on this device: "play <song>", "play something by <artist>". The files are played where they are; nothing is copied, and nothing leaves the device.
lm.permission: The browser asks once per start: tap “Allow the music folder”.
lm.session: Songs chosen for this session only: they are gone at the next start.
lm.no_picker: This browser can't keep a folder (phones): choose songs instead.
lm.forget.sure: Forget the music folder? The songs themselves are not touched.
lm.privacy: Emkay reads the start of each file for its title, artist and album, as OVOS does on a device. The list stays in this browser.
